verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains general claims about running global payroll (150+ countries, unified data) but no specific mention of direct deposit speed (next-day or 2-day) or check-replacement wire/ACH capability for employees. Community evidence even suggests Deel pushed a proprietary 'Deel Wallet' card rather than standard bank deposit, but this isn't framed against a documented claim. Missing for 10: any documentation of direct deposit timing, ACH/bank transfer speed, or comparison to check payments.
